caveats.statement: Some posts have no owner (OwnerUserId is NULL), so joins to users may drop them.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some users have no age recorded (Age is NULL), affecting average age calculations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Age IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some posts have no favorite count (FavoriteCount is NULL), affecting max favorite calculations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE FavoriteCount IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some posts have no view count (ViewCount is NULL), affecting average view calculations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some votes have no bounty amount (BountyAmount is NULL), affecting sum of bounty calculations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE BountyAmount IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some tags have no excerpt post (ExcerptPostId is NULL), affecting excerpt post lookups.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE ExcerptPostId IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some tags have no wiki post (WikiPostId is NULL), affecting wiki post lookups.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE WikiPostId IS NULL;
